display.purpose: Marketing page-head h1 and closing-band h2. Schibsted 800, 18–20ch measure, balanced.

subhead.purpose: Legal h2s and the short link inside the hero link object.

figure.purpose: Proof numerals in the marketing figure strip.

title.purpose: Dashboard page titles and StatStrip values.

small.purpose: Table cells, buttons, labels, menu items, tabs.

meta.purpose: Column headers, hints, chips, captions, source lines.

data.purpose: Geist Mono tabular figures: clicks, dates, API keys, kbd, code.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, dialogs, tooltips, command palette; always with a 1px line border. Dark: oklch(0 0 0 / 55%).

motion.name: ease-overlay
motion.purpose: Default easing for overlays, sheets and state transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color transitions on buttons and fields; overlay and fade exits (ease-in).

motion.name: fresh-row
motion.purpose: Newly created table row fades from signal-wash.

motion.name: key-reveal
motion.purpose: Marketing demo: the new key writes itself in via clip-path wipe.

motion.name: qr-resolve
motion.purpose: Marketing demo: the QR resolves top-to-bottom like a scanner pass after the key.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses every animation and transition; marketing reveals are gated behind no-preference.

breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 16 to 24px; marketing nav expands; dashboard table/list switch.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Full sidebar above, icon rail below (custom 75rem).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Navy fill for the one primary action in a view; inverts to white-on-navy inside a band.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.125rem var(--font-ui, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); border-radius: var(--control-radius, 6px); border: 0; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, oklch(0.545 0.19 262)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.208 0.042 265.755)); color: var(--primary-fg, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, oklch(0.285 0.05 265)); }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Bordered field; signal border plus 1px ring on focus, signal caret.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg, oklch(0.208 0.042 265.755)); } .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--field, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, oklch(0.87 0.014 265)); border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.54 0.025 265 / 0.5); } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: var(--signal, oklch(0.545 0.19 262)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--signal, oklch(0.545 0.19 262)); } .ds-input input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: 0.8125rem/1.125rem inherit; color: var(--fg, oklch(0.208 0.042 265.755)); caret-color: var(--signal, oklch(0.545 0.19 262)); } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-subtle, oklch(0.54 0.025 265)); }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Underline tabs over a hairline; 2px navy bar marks the active tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(0.925 0.01 265)); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tab { position: relative; margin-bottom: -1px; height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg-muted, oklch(0.46 0.03 265)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab[aria-selected=true] { color: var(--fg, oklch(0.208 0.042 265.755)); } .ds-tab[aria-selected=true]::after { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.208 0.042 265.755)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, oklch(0.545 0.19 262)); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.css: .ds-chips { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; max-width: 8rem; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: var(--chip-radius, 4px); background: oklch(0.208 0.042 265.755 / 6%); color: var(--fg-muted, oklch(0.46 0.03 265)); font: 0.75rem/1rem var(--font-ui, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-chip-more { font-family: var(--font-data, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 2fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(0.925 0.01 265)); font: 0.8125rem/1.125rem var(--font-ui, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--fg, oklch(0.208 0.042 265.755)); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle, oklch(0.985 0.004 265)); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, oklch(0.545 0.19 262)); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-key { font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-dom { font-weight: 400; color: var(--fg-subtle, oklch(0.54 0.025 265)); } .ds-dest { color: var(--fg-muted, oklch(0.46 0.03 265)); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-num { font-family: var(--font-data, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Shortn is the category standard executed at full craft, with Linear and Dub.co as the bar. It's a quiet, dense working surface for editors who create dozens of links a day. Brand navy is the ink and the primary fill, the neutrals are tinted with the same navy hue (265), and one signal blue marks whatever is interactive or in focus. Structure comes from 1px hairlines and space rather than boxes. The table is the product: 44px rows, tabular figures, and actions that apply instantly. Light mode is the default (a daylit desk) and dark mode is navy-black, not grey.

The marketing site is the same world at display scale, not a separate brand. Brand-navy **bands** own whole stretches of the page: the header and hero, the proof strip, and the closing call to action. White or dark-navy reading bands sit between them. Inside a band the tokens are remapped, so every dashboard control works unchanged on navy. Schibsted Grotesk 800, a news-publisher grotesque whose heavy weight echoes the logo's "S", is used only for marketing display type. Everything else is Geist.

The system explicitly rejects KPI card mosaics, decorative gradients, glassmorphism and glows, icon-in-rounded-square tiles, nested boxes, and the centred-slogan-over-floating-dashboard hero.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-tinted neutrals on white (navy-black in dark mode). Brand navy is used for ink and primary fills.
One signal blue, reserved for focus, text links, selection and chart series 1.
1px hairlines instead of cards. The only shadow belongs to floating overlays.
Geist for UI, Geist Mono for figures. Schibsted Grotesk 800 for marketing display only.
Small radii: 4 / 6 / 8 px, and 0 for rows and page sections.
Short, functional motion (120–180 ms). Reduced motion collapses it all.

rules.name: The Ink Is the Brand Rule
rules.body: Brand navy is the text color and the primary fill. There is no second brand color, and new palette work extends navy rather than replacing it.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal blue appears only where the user can act or is focused: links, focus, selection, the caret, checked controls and chart series 1. It never colors checkmarks, code strings, icons or decoration.

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red describe state. They never decorate or categorize.

rules.name: The Remap, Don't Restyle Rule
rules.body: A navy surface is made by putting content inside `.band`, which remaps tokens. Never make a navy variant of a component.

rules.name: The Two-Scale Rule
rules.body: The dashboard uses the 12–28 px Geist ramp. The display, headline, subhead, figure and lede sizes exist only in the marketing layer (`apps/web/src/app/globals.css`) and never appear in the app.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number a reader compares (clicks, scans, counts, prices, dates in tables) uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Heavy-or-Nothing Display Rule
rules.body: Schibsted appears only at weight 800, or 700 for the link-object key, with negative tracking between −0.02 and −0.035em. It is never used for body text.

rules.name: The Hairline, Not Box Rule
rules.body: Group things with a 1px `line` rule and space. A bordered container is allowed only around a self-contained object (an overlay, a field, the link object, a product capture), and never inside another bordered container.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only something floating above the page gets a shadow. If it sits in the page flow, it gets a hairline.

rules.name: The 4/6/8/0 Rule
rules.body: No radius outside this scale. In particular, no `rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl` panels.

dos: Do take every color from the semantic tokens (`bg`, `fg`, `line`, `signal` …) so light, dark and `.band` remaps all work without variants.
Do separate content with a 1px `line` hairline and space. Stats go in a single hairline-divided strip.
Do keep signal blue for links, focus, selection, checked controls and chart series 1.
Do use tabular Geist Mono for figures a reader compares.
Do keep motion between 120 and 180ms on `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)`, keep row hover and selection instant, and let `prefers-reduced-motion` collapse everything.
Do open marketing pages on a navy band and close long ones on another, with Schibsted 800 display type at negative tracking.
Do use 16px lucide icons inline with text, only where they carry meaning.
donts: Don't build KPI card grids, nested bordered boxes, or `rounded-2xl` panels.
Don't use decorative gradients, glassmorphism, glows, blurred blobs or "AI sparkle" iconography.
Don't use icon-in-rounded-square tiles as decoration.
Don't put a shadow on in-page content, including product screenshots.
Don't color checkmarks, code strings or decoration with signal blue.
Don't use display sizes or Schibsted Grotesk inside the dashboard.
Don't add eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't put a centred slogan over a floating dashboard mock with a logo wall.
